Dani (AE): Passing Arborly to CS — closed today. Quick context: dedicated deployment (reserved GPU pool), SAML SSO, on‑prem connector, go‑live target 2024-06-10. Pilot = 2 weeks, then production. Primary contacts: Claire (Arborly PM) and Jamie (Arborly Infra). Open items: SSO metadata, IP allowlist, provisioning ETA. Assigning @Priya to lead the handoff and kickoff.
Priya (CSM): Thanks @Dani — taking ownership. Can someone drop SSO metadata + contact emails here? I need staging access for tests. I'll schedule the kickoff for next Tue.
Maya (Solutions Engineer): I'll run the technical pre-checks. Need SSO metadata and a sample SP config. Also note they asked for batch embedding fallback; will include in runbook. I'll be tech owner for integration.
Dani (AE): SSO metadata sent via DM and email thread — I'll drop the file into the shared drive. Sales created ENG-8421 for the connector work (link: https://rwd/jira/browse/ENG-8421).
Luis (Support Eng): Looping in @Raj for provisioning approvals. I'll own SSO/staging validation once ENG-8421 is triaged. Created support triage ticket TICKET-5567 to track env/setup blockers.
Priya (CSM): Next steps (high level): 1) Provision dedicated pool (CS Ops) 2) Kickoff + onboarding workshop (Maya & Priya) 3) SSO test + staging validation (Luis) 4) Pilot success criteria doc & metrics (Priya). I'll create a shared checklist and invite Claire.
Raj (CS Ops): Ops note: we need their outbound IP ranges and preferred maintenance windows. @Dani please confirm permitted IPs. Provision ETA is ~5 business days after we receive IP list and SSO metadata.
Maya (Solutions Engineer): For the workshop I'll prepare a concise runbook + demo prompts. Also will capture performance baseline (latency/cost) and include a short feedback form: https://forms.rwd/onboard-feedback.
Priya (CSM): Adding renewal/health plan: 30/60/90 day check-ins. Early risk signal = pilot token usage <10% of forecast or repeated SSO failures.
Dani (AE): FYI sales closed at enterprise tier with a one‑year renewal discount clause — include finance on billing plan. cc @Aisha.
Aisha (Finance): Noted. Please send signed SOW and billing contact so I can set up invoicing.
onboarding-bot: Provisioning window reserved for Arborly: 2024-05-28 to 2024-05-31. Please confirm by EOD.
Priya (CSM): Confirming — scheduling kickoff Tue 2024-05-28 10:00 PT. Invite + checklist to follow. I'll attach the pilot success metrics template in the calendar event.
Luis (Support Eng): I'll queue ENG-8421 for triage and post updates here. If triage finds infra blockers I'll escalate to eng-runtime.
Priya (CSM): Owner summary (for the record): Priya — overall CSM lead; Maya — tech/runbook lead; Luis — staging & SSO validation; Raj — provisioning & ops; Dani — sales/exec liaison; Aisha — billing/finance. Action owners assigned.
Dani (AE): :thumbsup: thanks team — call me if SSO requires special cert chains or nonstandard metadata.
Priya (CSM): I'll capture this thread into the onboarding doc in /docs/onboarding/Arborly and ping #cs-onboarding when the checklist is live. Any immediate blockers, reply here and I'll triage.
